drg.description: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease with MCC

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient seen and examined at bedside. 53-year-old female admitted for COPD exacerbation. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.52, creatinine 0.92, hemoglobin 12.4, platelets 245, sodium 139, wbc 9.4; vitals dbp 75-77, heart_rate 82-87, map 93-95, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 15-16, sbp 129-135, spo2 96-97, temp 36.7-36.9
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Albuterol-ipratropium nebulizer; Prednisone 40 mg PO
Assessment and plan: COPD exacerbation. Acute hypoxic respiratory failure.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient seen and examined at bedside. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.9, hemoglobin 12.2, platelets 247, sodium 139, wbc 9.3; vitals dbp 74-78, heart_rate 82-85, map 93-96, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 14-16, sbp 129-135, spo2 96-98, temp 36.7-36.9
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Albuterol-ipratropium nebulizer; Prednisone 40 mg PO
Assessment and plan: COPD exacerbation. Acute hypoxic respiratory failure. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 53-year-old female, length of stay 3 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: COPD exacerbation. Acute hypoxic respiratory failure. Follow up with primary care in one week. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed.
